title: The Night Before the Tournament
next_chapter_hook: As the moon set and crows cawed, when Chen Ji stepped out of his dilapidated hut, the Sect Gate of Tianqing Sect loomed before him in the morning light—the three-day tournament was about to begin, and he had prepared to make everyone's jaw drop.

text.content: The night was as dark as ink, with sparse cold stars. Inside that dilapidated hut in the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters, a solitary lamp flickered, casting Chen Ji's shadow onto the mottled earthen wall like a beast lying in ambush. On the table lay an unrolled sheepskin scroll, glowing with a dim light—the incomplete Tianji Record, now trembling slightly as if sensing the turmoil in its master's heart. Chen Ji took a deep breath, his fingertips gently brushing across the yellowed pages, a faint vein pulsing at his brow center. Tomorrow's tournament required not just strength, but an absolutely foolproof plan.

dialogue.content: "Boy, don't bite off more than you can chew." The residual soul's voice drifted from the depths of the scroll, carrying a lazy warning. "Each glimpse of the future through the Tianji Record costs five Heavenly Fate points. Do you have any idea how many you have left?" Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold smirk, his voice extremely low: "Seventy points. Enough for fourteen uses." The residual soul fell silent for a moment, then sighed: "Remember, the longer you peer, the heavier the backlash. Don't overextend yourself..." The voice gradually faded into the night wind.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, the cyan light of the Tianji Record swirling around his fingertips. He sank his consciousness into that mysterious scroll, attempting to glimpse the future's trajectory one more time before the tournament began. The images blurred and flickered—the outline of the arena platform, the noisy crowd, and a hazy figure approaching him. However, at the crucial moment, the images shattered abruptly, like a mirror being struck, fragments scattering everywhere. "What's going on?" Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, fine cold sweat beading on his forehead. The residual soul's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of gravity: "Insufficient Heavenly Fate, or... there's an interference source."

Interference source? Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly. He immediately thought of one possibility—Chen Nian. His sister, that existence taken by the Holy Sect as a "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." Whenever predictions involved her, the images would blur. Could she have already arrived near Tianqing Sect? Chen Ji clenched his fist, fingernails almost piercing his palm. No, he told himself. What mattered most now was tomorrow's Sect Tournament. As long as he shocked everyone in the tournament, he could gain more resources, get closer to the core circle, and pave the way for finding Chen Nian.

dialogue.content: Just then, soft knocking came at the door. Three knocks, unhurried and measured, carrying an intentional composure. Chen Ji's eyes sharpened, his hand stealthily reaching toward the short blade beneath his pillow. At this hour, who would come to see a Servant Disciple? "Chen Ji, I know you're not asleep." A cold female voice came from outside the door, like ice springs striking stones, "Open the door." Chen Ji paused slightly. He knew that voice too well—Su Qingyao, Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, cold and formidable, the only person who had sensed something wrong with him.

text.content: Chen Ji quickly concealed the cold light in his eyes, replacing it with a timid, terrified expression. He opened the door, and standing outside was indeed Su Qingyao. Under the moonlight, she wore a moon-white long dress, her blue-black hair like cascading waterfalls, her skin snow-white, beautiful as if she didn't belong to the mortal world. Yet her gaze was like a sharp sword, piercing directly toward Chen Ji. "Su... Su Senior Sister?" Chen Ji "flustered" took a step back, his voice trembling, "It's so late, how could you possibly..." Su Qingyao said nothing, merely observing him quietly, as if trying to see through him. After a long moment, she took a jade bottle from her sleeve and handed it to him.

dialogue.content: "Gathering Yuan Elixir." Su Qingyao's voice remained cold, but seemed to carry an imperceptible softness. "Tomorrow's tournament, you need this." Chen Ji froze, his expression one of "disbelief": "Senior Sister, this... such a precious elixir, how could a Servant Disciple like me possibly..." Su Qingyao cut him off: "Less nonsense." Her gaze lingered on his face for a moment,，似乎在寻找什么，最终却只是轻轻叹了口气，"大比之后，有些事我会亲自问你。现在，好好休息。"

text.content: Chen Ji took the jade bottle, and the moment his fingertips touched its surface, a warm spiritual energy fluctuation emanated from it. Gathering Yuan Elixir, a fourth-rank elixir—virtually a sky-high price for a Servant Disciple. Why would Su Qingyao give him something like this? Was it a test? Or did she have other motives? Alarm bells rang in his heart, but on the surface, he wore an expression of grateful tears: "Thank you, Senior Sister! Chen Ji will never forget your great kindness!" Su Qingyao watched his pathetic display, a fleeting complex emotion flickering in her eyes.

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's precious elixir, how should Chen Ji respond to this unexpected kindness?

choices.text: Express respectful gratitude, appearing overwhelmed and flattered
choices.description: Continue maintaining the waste persona, showing excessive gratitude and fear toward Su Qingyao's kindness, making her think he's merely a pathetic creature easily satisfied.

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister... this is truly too precious!" Chen Ji's hands trembled as he received the jade bottle, his voice shaking, "I... I'm just a Servant Disciple, how could I possibly..." He bowed deeply, his forehead nearly touching the ground, "Chen Ji will forever remember Senior Sister's great kindness!" Su Qingyao watched his performance quietly, her lips lifting slightly before quickly composing herself, "Alright, stop with the act. I've given you the elixir; whether you use it is your own business."

text.content: Her gaze lingered on him for a moment, as if wanting to say something, but she stopped herself. Eventually, she turned lightly, "Rest early." Under the moonlight, her figure faded into the distance, leaving a faint, ethereal fragrance. Chen Ji stood at the doorway, the panic on his face gradually fading, replaced by deep contemplation. Su Qingyao, what exactly do you want?

choices.text: Test and inquire, hinting that one doesn't need it
choices.description: Deliberately appear somewhat "excessively" submissive, hinting that giving elixirs to a waste is a waste, testing her true intentions.

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister..." Chen Ji lowered his head, gazing at the jade bottle in his hand, his voice trembling, "This elixir... can I really use it? I'm just a waste..." He raised his head, a flicker of vulnerability in his eyes, "What if I use it improperly and waste Senior Sister's kindness..." Su Qingyao's brow slightly furrowed: "You're quite the overthinker." She stepped forward, pressing the jade bottle into his hand, "Remember, in the tournament, don't trust anyone."

text.content: After saying this, she turned and left, leaving a "confused" Chen Ji standing in the night wind. Don't trust anyone, not even your sect? Such words from an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow were far from ordinary. Chen Ji gripped the jade bottle tightly, his gaze gradually deepening. Su Qingyao, your situation may be far more dangerous than I imagined.

choices.text: Silently accepting, silently remembering this debt of gratitude
choices.description: Accepting the elixir without arrogance or servility, asking no questions and showing little emotion, using silence to prevent Su Qingyao from seeing through his thoughts.
choices.risk_hint: Might make Su Qingyao even more curious

dialogue.content: Chen Ji said nothing, only accepting the jade bottle with both hands and giving a slight nod. His calm gaze met Su Qingyao's for a moment, as if they were exchanging something wordlessly. Su Qingyao was slightly stunned—this calmness... it was not befitting a废物. 'You...' She started to speak but stopped, finally just sighing. 'Fine. Remember what I said.' With that, her figure vanished into the night.

text.content: Chen Ji closed the door, lifting the jade bottle to examine it under the moonlight. The elixir radiated a gentle luster, clearly a superior quality. Su Qingyao, how much do you know? His fingers gently tapped the bottle, producing a clear sound. The information tonight was substantial—he needed to digest it all carefully. Yet one thing crystallized in his mind: Su Qingyao posed no immediate threat, at least not currently.

dialogue.content: 'Stop lingering there.' Su Qingyao's voice pierced through his contemplation, 'Speak inside.' Chen Ji 'hesitated' momentarily, stepping aside to clear the doorway. Moonlight flooded in alongside her, illuminating that coldly beautiful visage. She settled onto the room's sole wooden stool, her gaze sweeping across the decrepit dwelling before landing on the unrolled sheepskin scroll upon the table. 'What is that?' Her voice remained composed, yet her eyes cut like a blade.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart lurched, though his expression betrayed nothing. He 'frantically' moved forward, hastily gathering the sheepskin scroll while murmuring, 'It's... it's a family heirloom. I do not understand its purpose... I've had it since childhood...' Su Qingyao remained silent, her gaze fixed upon him. That stare seemed capable of piercing through any facade, sending an involuntary chill down Chen Ji's spine. Yet retreat was not an option. Any sign of panic now would only deepen her suspicion.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao has discovered the Tianji Record Fragment—how should Chen Ji navigate this crisis?

choices.description: Reveal the sheepskin scroll as a family heirloom while concealing the Tianji Record's true capabilities, admitting only to a slight foresight ability without elaborating.

dialogue.content: 'Since senior sister inquires...' Chen Ji 'struggled' to speak, 'Actually, with this thing... sometimes I can vaguely perceive things, but extremely hazy and unreliable...' He scratched his head, expression troubled, 'Perhaps this is why they call me a废物... always seeing useless things.'

text.content: Su Qingyao's expression subtly shifted. She studied Chen Ji at length, appearing to evaluate the authenticity of his words. 'Can you see the future?' Her voice remained even, yet carried a barely perceptible tremor. 'How far ahead?' Chen Ji pretended to deliberate. 'Sometimes... I can vaguely glimpse events a few hours ahead, but it is far from clear...' He forced a bitter smile. 'Hence why I call myself a废物—utterly useless.'

choices.description: Maintain that it is merely a common family heirloom, never mentioning foresight abilities, acting entirely unaware of its worth.

dialogue.content: 'I... I genuinely mean it is merely a family heirloom.' Chen Ji wore a 'bewildered' expression. 'I have no idea what it is—the characters inscribed are beyond my comprehension... If senior sister finds it peculiar, I... I could give it to you?' He extended the sheepskin scroll with both hands, presenting it like a martyr accepting his fate.

text.content: Su Qingyao declined. Her gaze oscillated between the sheepskin scroll and Chen Ji's face, as if calculating. Ultimately, she simply shook her head: 'Unnecessary.' Rising, she moved to the window, gazing out at the moonlit scenery. 'Chen Ji, I am unaware of what you are concealing. However, I must inform you of something.' A pause followed. 'The old sect master... finds you intriguing.'

choices.text: Counter with questions to probe Su Qingyao's motives
choices.description: Not answering directly, but asking why Su Qingyao came so late at night and why she cares about a废物, testing her bottom line.

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister..." Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, a sharpness flickering in his gaze that was completely at odds with his废物 image. "I have a question for you." Su Qingyao was slightly stunned, clearly not expecting him to speak like this. "Ask." Chen Ji stared directly into her eyes. "You're the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, with limitless prospects. Coming to a废物的 hut late at night, giving precious elixirs, and being so interested in an ancestral artifact... what exactly do you want?"

text.content: The room fell into a brief silence. Su Qingyao's gaze became intricate, as if she was re-evaluating this "废物" before her. After a long moment, she suddenly smiled. That smile was faint, yet like ice and snow beginning to thaw, brightening the entire small hut. "Interesting." she murmured softly, "You truly are... not what you appear to be."

dialogue.content: "The old sect leader is very interested in you." Su Qingyao's voice suddenly turned grave. "I don't know if that's good or bad. But be careful." Chen Ji's heart tightened, though his face remained full of "confusion": "Old sect leader? Why would the old sect leader be interested in a废物 like me?" Su Qingyao shook her head, not answering. She sat back down on the wooden stool, her gaze falling on the flickering lamp light, her expression suddenly becoming somewhat dazed.

text.content: Moonlight leaked through the broken window lattice, casting mottled light patterns on the ground. Su Qingyao sat there, the lamplight illuminating her profile, revealing a hint of exhaustion in that aloof temperament. Chen Ji watched her quietly, speculating in his heart. This Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, the number one of the younger generation in the sect, had come to his废物's hut late at night, delivering elixirs and warnings... what was she after? And what did the words "don't trust anyone, including my sect" mean?

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister just said, don't trust anyone, including your sect..." Chen Ji spoke "cautiously," "what does that mean?" Su Qingyao glanced at him, seeming hesitant whether to say it. Finally, she lightly sighed: "Tianqing Sect... isn't as simple as it appears on the surface." Her voice was very low. "The old sect leader... his ambitions are far greater than you imagine. And this competition... may very well be a trap."

text.content: Trap? Chen Ji's brow slightly furrowed. Su Qingyao's words reminded him of those vague images in the Tianji Record—the outline of the arena, the clamoring crowd, and a blurry figure closing in on him. Could that haziness in his foresight be because of the "trap" Su Qingyao mentioned? "Why would Senior Sister tell me these things?" Chen Ji asked the doubt in his heart. "I'm just a Servant Disciple, what do these matters... have to do with me?"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, the lamplight dancing in her eyes, reflecting a complex interplay of shadows. "Because you're like me." Her voice was very soft, so light it might be scattered by the night wind. "We're both chess pieces." She raised her head, staring directly into Chen Ji's eyes. "You think you're hiding well? But the old sect leader's eyes never miss anyone with 'value.' Your incomplete Tianji Record... he's already noticed it."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart suddenly sank, but his expression maintained that fearful appearance. "T-Tianji Record?" he "stammered," "What is that? I... I really don't know..." Su Qingyao watched his appearance, then suddenly laughed softly. "Chen Ji, your acting is very good." She stood up, smoothing her dress. "But with me, you don't need to do this." She walked to the door, glanced back at him. "Tomorrow's competition, I'll be watching you. Don't die."

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to Su Qingyao's warning and departure?

choices.text: Thank her and try to keep her, asking why she helped himself.
choices.description: Show gratitude and some "genuine emotion," detain her to stay a while longer, trying to extract more information from her.

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister!" Chen Ji spoke "urgently," "Why are you telling me these things? We're... we're not related, why would you..." His voice carried a hint of trembling, as if touched by Su Qingyao's words. Su Qingyao stopped walking, her back facing him. Moonlight outlined her slender figure. "Because you remind me of someone." Her voice was very soft. "Someone... from a very long time ago."

text.content: After saying this, she pushed the door and left without looking back. Chen Ji stood in place, gazing at her disappearing back into the night, his brow tightly knit. Someone from a very long time ago? Su Qingyao's past seemed to hide some secret as well. And the word "chess piece" she mentioned made his heart alarm ring even more. It seems the waters of Tianqing Sect run deeper than he imagined.

choices.description: Don't ask much, just nod silently to show he remembers her warning, using silence to make Su Qingyao say more on her own.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji said nothing, merely nodding solemnly. Su Qingyao glanced at him, seemingly surprised by his silence, but said no more. She walked to the door, then suddenly stopped. "Oh, one more thing." She didn't turn around. "During the Sect Competition, Han Lie will target you. That guy... though foolish, his backing forces are no simple matter."

text.content: Her words fell, and her figure vanished into the night. Chen Ji closed the door and stored the jade bottle and sheepskin scroll carefully. Han Lie... the number one prodigy of Xuanwu Sect, the pinnacle of the brute-force path. A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. Come then, he'd like to see what "surprises" this simple-minded fellow could bring during the Sect Competition.

choices.text: Softly say thank you, and speak a meaningful sentence
choices.description: Say thank you in an unassuming yet dignified manner, and say something that surprises Su Qingyao, showing that you are not truly a废物.

dialogue.content: "Thank you for the reminder, Senior Sister." Chen Ji's voice suddenly became calm, the fear and trembling seemingly never having existed. "But Senior Sister should also be careful. The old Sect Master's eyes won't only be watching me." Su Qingyao turned abruptly, a flash of surprise in her eyes. Chen Ji smiled faintly at her. "Senior Sister said we are both chess pieces, but even chess pieces have their uses. Tomorrow's Sect Competition, Senior Sister just watch the show."

text.content: Su Qingyao stared at him for a long time, complex light flickering in her eyes. In the end, she merely nodded lightly: "Interesting." She pushed open the door, her footsteps gradually fading. Inside the room, Chen Ji stood alone under the moonlight, his fingers gently stroking the pages of the Tianji Record. Su Qingyao... Ling Yuan... Han Lie... this Sect Competition seemed even more lively than he had anticipated. But it was fine, the more who came, the more he could exploit.

dialogue.content: After Su Qingyao left, Chen Ji stood alone under the moonlight. He poured the Gathering Yuan Elixir from the jade bottle. The elixir radiated a warm luster in his palm, its spiritual energy abundant—a top-quality product among the finest. He smiled lightly and stored the elixir away. "Interesting..." he murmured to himself. "Su Qingyao, are you friend or foe?" Night wind blew through the broken window, making the lamp flicker. Chen Ji stood by the window for a long time, his gaze profound as an abyss. Ling Yuan, the Tianji Record, the Sect Competition... all clues pointed in the same direction—this Sect Competition was far from simple.

text.content: He sat back at the table and spread open the Tianji Record. The fragmented pages glowed with a faint green light under the moonlight, like a slumbering beast. Chen Ji took a deep breath and dove his consciousness into it. This time, he didn't try to glimpse the future but delved deeper into the pages. Blurred images flashed—the Arena Platform, crowds, a vague figure... then是一片黑暗, darkness with countless eyes watching him. Heavenly Dao's Eyes! Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, cold sweat forming on his forehead. The images within this fragment seemed to be hinting at something to him.

dialogue.content: "Boy, what did you see?" The fragmentary soul's voice rang out, carrying a weight of gravity. Chen Ji shook his head, saying nothing. But in his heart, he already had a vague guess—this Sect Competition might not just be a contest between sects, but possibly a game played by some great beings. And he, along with the Tianji Record, were merely pieces in this chess game. But so what? Since he was a chess piece, he'd be one that could stir up the entire game. He stood up, his gaze falling on the moonlit scenery outside the window. Tomorrow would be the moment to witness the miracle.

text.content: Chen Ji returned to the simple wooden bed but didn't immediately fall asleep. He sat cross-legged with the Gathering Yuan Elixir in his mouth. The moment the elixir entered his body, a warm force flowed through his meridians, as if countless small hands were gently massaging his eight extraordinary meridians. He closed his eyes and operated his cultivation technique, guiding that medicinal force to strike the bottleneck that hadn't loosened for so long. The spiritual energy in his body was like a flooded river, wave after wave crashing against that barrier... a soft "crack" sounded, as if something had shattered.

Qi Refining Seventh Stage! Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a flash of delight in them. The Gathering Yuan Elixir truly deserved its rank-four status—the medicinal effect was so strong it directly helped him break through the Qi Refining Sixth Stage bottleneck, reaching Qi Refining Seventh Stage! Feeling the abundant spiritual energy in his body, Chen Ji's lips curved with satisfaction. Qi Refining Seventh Stage, while not top-tier among Inner Disciples, was enough to give him a fighting chance in the Sect Competition. More importantly, he still had the Tianji Record as his trump card. Combined with the ability to foresee three hours ahead, he was confident he could stir up a storm in the competition.

Outside the window, the east had begun to brighten. The first light of dawn penetrated the thin mist, shining on the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, and on Chen Ji's平静而深邃 face. He stood up and stretched, feeling the unprecedented power in his body. Qi Refining Seventh Stage, not bad. But not enough. He needed to display sufficient strength in the Sect Competition, yet not too world-shaking. After all, he still had to continue playing the role of the despised废物. Putting on the faded Outer Disciple/Servant robe, Chen Ji pushed open the door. The Tianqing Sect Competition, opening today.

The Tianqing Sect was far more lively than usual in the morning. Disciples walked in groups toward the Martial Arena, their chatter rising and falling. "Did you hear? This competition, both Xuanwu Sect and Holy Sword Sect sent people to observe!" "Yes, the top young prodigies of three major sects will all participate—the scene will be spectacular!" "Do you think that废物 Chen Ji will participate? Doesn't he sign up every year and get eliminated in the first round every year?" "Hahaha, that废物 still has the face to sign up? If I were him, I'd have hidden and been too ashamed to see anyone!" Chen Ji passed by them, turning a deaf ear to those mocking voices. He lowered his head, but a faint, undetectable cold smile curved his lips. Go ahead and laugh. When the competition ends, let's see who's laughing then.

The Martial Arena was already packed with people. On the high platform, Tianqing Sect's high-ranking members took their seats one by one. The old Sect Master Ling Yuan sat in the central position, white-haired and white-bearded, with an air of immortal elegance. His gaze swept through the crowd and finally landed on Chen Ji, a meaningful smile curving his lips. Nearby, Su Qingyao stood quietly, her gaze also fixed on Chen Ji, her expression complex. On the other side of the high platform, a tall and sturdy young man with a cold, stern face was staring at Chen Ji with hostile eyes—that was Han Lie, the number one prodigy of Xuanwu Sect.

Chen Ji felt those gazes but maintained his timid appearance, standing in an unnoticeable corner of the crowd with his head lowered. His gaze swept across the high platform, memorizing every detail. The old Sect Master, Su Qingyao, Han Lie... and those gazes hidden in the shadows—all were captured by him one by one. Now, he just needed to wait for the competition to begin, waiting for that moment that would make everyone's eyes pop. The jade bottle at his chest was slightly warm—that was the empty bottle of the Gathering Yuan Elixir Su Qingyao had given him last night. He hadn't thrown it away but kept it close. This, was a kind of tacit understanding between him and Su Qingyao.

"Competition begins!" With the Law Enforcement Elder's loud proclamation, the entire Martial Arena fell silent in an instant. Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze cutting through the crowd toward that massive Arena Platform. Morning light fell, illuminating the platform in golden splendor, like a sacred battlefield. Around the Arena Platform, layers of formations had already been set up to prevent spiritual energy fluctuations during the match from harming the spectators. Everything, was ready. Chen Ji took a deep breath, a sharp gleam flashing in his eyes.废物? Let me show you just how far a废物 can go!
